  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable u (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict V) ∧
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable G (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict V) ∧
      ∃ φ,
        (∀ (n : ℕ), CoarseDeGiorgi.IsSmoothCore a V (φ n)) ∧
          (∀ (ε : ℝ),
              0 < ε →
                ∃ N,
                  ∀ (m n : ℕ),
                    N ≤ m →
                      N ≤ n →
                        (ENNReal.ofReal ((Homogenization.volumeAverage V fun x => φ n x - φ m x) ^ 2) +
                            CoarseDeGiorgi.weightedEnergy a V fun x =>
                              CoarseDeGiorgi.smoothGrad (φ n) x - CoarseDeGiorgi.smoothGrad (φ m) x) <
                          ENNReal.ofReal ε) ∧
            (∀ (K : Set (Homogenization.Vec d)),
                IsCompact K →
                  K ⊆ V →
                    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ (x : Homogenization.Vec d) in K, ‖φ n x - u x‖ₑ) Filter.atTop
                      (nhds 0)) ∧
              Filter.Tendsto
                (fun n => CoarseDeGiorgi.weightedEnergy a V fun x => CoarseDeGiorgi.smoothGrad (φ n) x - G x)
                Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
